subject: Post-call: Subprocessors, SOC2 & vendor questionnaire — action items
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: 
Date: Tue, 06 Jan 2026 17:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: Subprocessors, SOC2 & vendor questionnaire — action items

Hi Chris / MedicaRo security team,

Thanks again for taking the discovery call earlier — good conversation. Per our call, here are the immediate items Redwood can provide to help your security and procurement teams evaluate us: 

1) Current SOC 2 Type II report (most recent year) + scope notes
2) Complete subprocessor list and short description of each (role: infra, monitoring, analytics)
3) Completed vendor security questionnaire template (we can do CSV/XLSX)
4) Short note on data flow boundaries: what we persist, where we cache, and how keys are managed

Requests / clarifications we heard from your team:
- HIPAA applicability for PHI in workflows — you mentioned some use cases will touch PHI
- Encryption and KMS options (customer-managed recommended?)
- Retention windows and audit log retention requirements
- AWS / GCP usage and whether any downstream sharing occurs with partners

Proposed next steps:
- I’ll share the SOC2 and subprocessor doc by EOD tomorrow (Jan 7).
- Can you confirm who should receive the completed security questionnaire (procurement vs security ops)?
- If HIPAA applies, we should schedule a 30-min security call to walk controls and DPA terms.

I’m cc’ing our security and legal leads so we can move quickly.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0192

Attachment: initial-eval-checklist.txt (stub)
From: Chris Leung <chris.leung@medicaro.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@medicaro.com, procurement@medicaro.com
Date: Wed, 07 Jan 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Subprocessors, SOC2 & vendor questionnaire — action items

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the clear list. A few quick clarifications from my side:

- HIPAA: yes, several customers will route PHI through the service for clinical note summarization. We need explicit confirmation that Redwood supports HIPAA-covered workloads and is willing to sign a DPA/BAA.
- KMS: we prefer customer-managed keys for encrypted-at-rest material if possible. Is CMK supported in Dedicated/Private options?
- Subprocessors: please include cloud providers (AWS regions used), any monitoring vendors (e.g., Datadog), and any analytics/telemetry vendors.
- Retention: our baseline requirement is 90 days for requests, 1 year for audit logs — can you confirm your default and any configurable retention for logs and KV cache?

Procurement: please send the security questionnaire to procurement@medicaro.com.

If you can get the SOC2 + subprocessors by Friday (Jan 9) that would be great. We may also ask for the SOC2 bridge letter if available.

—Chris
Head of InfoSec, MedicaRo Health

Team — forwarding MedicaRo questions (below). They flagged HIPAA, KMS/CMK, and retention windows. Can Legal / Security confirm the following by EOD?

1) SOC2: latest report and whether a bridge letter exists for 2026 (we told them Type II 2025)
2) Subprocessor list: produce a customer-ready PDF that lists role, vendor, and short notes on data access
3) DPA/BAA: do we have a standard BAA or process to review DPA redlines?
4) Retention: canonical statement on request and audit log retention; list configurable options by deployment type (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)

Blocking items: if we can confirm CMK support in Dedicated/Private and provide the subprocessor PDF, procurement will accept the questionnaire.

Thanks — Karthik

Karthik — quick update from Legal & Security: 

- SOC2: Attached is the final SOC 2 Type II report for 2025 and the attestation letter. (Attachment: SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf)
- Subprocessors: Attached a vetted subprocessor PDF. We list AWS (us-west-2, us-east-1), GCP (europe-west3) for hosting, Datadog for monitoring (no access to plaintext customer prompts), S3-like object store providers, and a limited analytics partner for anonymized metrics. The doc includes role descriptions and contact info for SOC evidence.
- KMS / CMK: Customer-managed keys are supported in Dedicated and Private deployments. For Hosted we offer envelope encryption with keys we control; we can discuss custom arrangements for HIPAA customers.
- Retention: Default request cache retention is 7 days for Hosted; configurable to 90 days for Dedicated/Private. Audit logs retention default is 1 year; extended retention can be negotiated on Dedicated/Private.
- BAA: We have a standard BAA; Legal will send a copy and is available to review redlines.

Action items for KB: please attach the subprocessor PDF and SOC2 to the outbound to MedicaRo and confirm the questionnaire recipient. Legal will monitor the DPA/BAA thread.

—Marissa
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Post-call: Subprocessors, SOC2 & vendor questionnaire — action items

Chris / Procurement — attaching the items Marissa sent: SOC2 report and our subprocessors PDF. I’ve also attached the completed vendor security questionnaire for your procurement team to ingest. A few clarifying points inline below and next steps: 

- HIPAA: Redwood supports HIPAA workloads in Dedicated and Private. We will sign a BAA; Legal (Marissa) is on the thread to share the standard BAA and review any redlines. Hosted customers can be supported under limited conditions — recommend Dedicated for PHI workloads.
- KMS: CMK supported in Dedicated/Private. If you require customer-managed KMS on Hosted, we’ll need to discuss a custom arrangement.
- Data sharing: Redwood does not share customer prompt or response content with downstream partners except for the listed infrastructure and analytics subprocessors. Our subprocessor PDF flags roles that have no access to plaintext (e.g., Datadog receives metrics only).
- Retention: Default cache retention for Hosted is 7 days; Dedicated/Private can be configured to 90 days. Audit logs default 1 year; can be extended.

Attachments: Redwood_Subprocessors_Q1_2026.pdf; SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf; Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Completed.xlsx

Next steps:
1) Procurement to confirm receipt of questionnaire and confirm any missing fields (procurement@medicaro.com).
2) Security call: propose Tue, Jan 13 or Wed, Jan 14 for a 30-min deep dive with Vivek and Marissa on controls and the BAA. Which day works for your team?
3) If HIPAA applies, we’ll prioritize the BAA review.

Thanks — look forward to moving this along.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
